title: Privacy Policy
summaryHtml: Navigo uses location to provide nearby transit information and active-trip features. Crash diagnostics are opt-in, analytics can be disabled, and personal data is not sold. Online maps and downloads involve the providers described below.
bodyHtml:
1. Controller and contact

The data controller is Rendra Prasetia, known as lscythe, an individual developer in Indonesia. Send privacy requests to contact@navigo.app.

2. Data Navigo uses

  • Location while the app is open, to show your position, sort nearby stops, and provide transit features.
  • Background location only while a trip or get-off alarm you started is active. Ending it stops this use.
  • A random installation identifier and Play Integrity evidence, used for security, abuse prevention, and installation checks. It is not an advertising ID.
  • Crash diagnostics only if you opt in, including the error, app version, device model, and operating-system version.
  • Usage analytics, if enabled, including screen and feature usage counts. You can disable analytics in the app.

3. Why data is processed

Location and optional diagnostics or analytics rely on your consent. Active-trip features are processed to provide the service you requested. Installation security and abuse prevention rely on the Developer's legitimate interest in keeping Navigo safe and reliable. You may withdraw consent in Navigo or your device settings.

4. Processors and maps

Crash diagnostics and analytics are processed by the providers identified in the app's privacy settings. Google processes app delivery, updates, and Play Integrity checks under its own terms.

Online maps use OpenFreeMap data delivered with Cloudflare. A tile request reveals the viewed map area, IP address, and basic request metadata. Navigo does not send precise device coordinates as a separate field to OpenFreeMap. OpenFreeMap states that it does not normally retain IP addresses, but may retain them for up to 30 days during a security incident.

The Jakarta offline package is downloaded from Navigo-controlled storage. The hosting provider receives the IP address and request metadata for the download. Viewing the downloaded package later does not reveal which locations you view.

5. Retention and sharing

Navigo does not sell personal data and contains no advertising SDK. Local trip and alarm state remains on your device until you remove it or uninstall the app. Security records are retained only as long as needed to prevent abuse. Crash and analytics retention follows the periods shown by their processors in the app's privacy settings.

6. Your rights

You may ask to access, correct, delete, or export personal data, object to processing, or withdraw consent. Write to contact@navigo.app. Requests are handled without charge and normally answered within 30 days.

7. Security and children

Traffic is encrypted in transit and access to stored data is limited. No formal security certification is claimed. Navigo is not directed at children under 13 and does not knowingly collect their personal data.

8. Changes and complaints

Material changes will be announced in the app before they take effect where reasonably possible. Contact contact@navigo.app first with a complaint. You may also complain to the competent Indonesian personal-data-protection authority or another authority with jurisdiction.
